name: Ed van Dyke
source: Ed is as kind and friendly as his wife, Molly. Together they run a café, which they opened several years back. Ed is in charge of the kitchen, and he's a great cook. He has always led a simple life and never wanted for anything more than to have a happy and fulfilling life near those he loves. His only regret is not having had a son...
